evidence_records.$comment: 3.1.0: provisional run records the artifact relies on by hash, without inheriting their labels (Geant4 phase 2); resolved by contracts/dependencies.py

argv.$comment: 3.11.0 (ART-70): the argument array actually executed, interpreter first; written by evaluate_design.py (M1) and run_workflow.py (M2); contracts/design.py finds the tool contract from the script in it

parameter_digest.$comment: 3.11.0 (detector design M2, INC-02): the digest of the design parameters the step reads (evaluate_design.py run --digest-only), written by run_workflow.py; the incremental skip key compares it instead of the candidate files' hashes

script_sha256.$comment: 3.11.0 (ART-70): SHA-256 of each script file named in argv, keyed by the path as it appears in argv

search_summary.$comment: CV-C1 (geant4 program C1.6; declared with hep-computing's agreement): written only by evaluate_design.py search: the search spec and design-spec hashes, the optimizer and seed, the distinct designs evaluated with their search values, the non-binding search front, the hypervolume history and the finalists. The field rules are contracts/schemas/design_search_summary.json, applied by contracts/validate.py from SEARCH_SUMMARY_FROM on (or strict); exempt from the orphan-run rule; a search value is not an evaluation and supports no verdict until its point is expanded into a candidate and evaluated

scan_summary.$comment: 3.11.0 (detector design M4, AGG-08, OQ-18): written only by evaluate_design.py scan: the points of a parameter scan of one candidate and figure of merit (parameters, value, uncertainty, bound per point) and the local sensitivities; exempt from the orphan-run rule; a point is not an evaluation and supports no verdict until it is expanded into a candidate and evaluated
